title: Trailer
sub: Algorythmic Explorations in twenty-five seconds, cut to the song's peak. A galaxy spiralling out of dust, a wave of particles, the lava lamp, lightning and terrain raised from noise.

title: Bounced Light
sub: Five of the light pieces, played with live. Embers over a bonfire, a lamp carried from a red wall to a green one, a lava lamp warming up, light painted on the walls and smoke blown through shafts of sun. It's all lit in real time with radiance cascades.

title: Particle Worlds
sub: A tank of 45,000 water particles splashed around with the cursor. Then a ring of dust collapsing under its own gravity into galaxies, and about 590,000 particles growing into a cosmic web.

title: Ground Truth
sub: A sunset flight over terrain that never runs out, a meadow moving in the wind, and a valley carved by ninety thousand simulated raindrops. Everything is generated live in the browser from noise.

title: Thirteen Live Figures
sub: The film from the home page, thirteen pieces a few seconds each. Galaxies, water, fireworks, a bonfire, a lava lamp, a ferrofluid crown, a firing neuron, a synthesizer and a flight to the horizon.
